name: Garrick
want: a lever to lift the millstones
reply: a lever to lift the millstones.
does: raises the heavy millstones for grinding
reasons: the beam would strike the pivot_block and post_a and post_b as it moved
it would not lift: nothing in it raises a load
drawing:
Garrick, the old one was a mess. The beam sat right on top of the pivot, so when it swung, it just bonked into the stone and the other post. And it didn't actually lift anything.

I've fixed it. I've made the beam a solid crossbar, so it can't twist into the posts. I've put the pivot on the very end, so the whole arm swings clear. And I've put a heavy counterweight on the short end. Now, when you push the handle down, the heavy side pulls the other end up. It lifts the stone.

Here is the mending.
